title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Status Rules: Upgrades, Annual Reassessment and Co-Brand Card Floors
content:
## 1. Upgrade

A member is upgraded on the day the elite night credits of the current calendar year — the night credits posted from January 1 to that day less the night credits reversed in the same period — first reach the qualifying nights of a higher tier and, for a tier whose qualifying spend is above zero, the qualifying spend of the same period also reaches that spend. The qualifying spend of a period is the eligible spend of the base points transactions posted in it less the eligible spend removed by the stay credit reversals posted in it. The upgrade takes effect that day and is guaranteed through the last day of the tier's closing month of the calendar year that lies the tier's number of guaranteed years after the year of qualification.

## 2. Protection and annual reassessment

A tier is never removed before the last day it is guaranteed. On March 1 every member whose guaranteed period has passed is reassessed: the new tier is the highest tier whose thresholds are met by the night credits and qualifying spend of the prior calendar year, but not lower than the downgrade floor of the tier held, and the new guaranteed period is computed from the prior year as the year of qualification.

## 3. Co-brand card floors

Holding an Ashbury Rewards co-brand card changes the tier: a member whose linked card appears in the card floor table holds at least the tier listed for it, with no guaranteed-through date, for as long as the card stays linked; when the card is closed the member keeps the higher of the tier earned by nights and the floor of any card still linked.

| Linked co-brand card | Tier floor while linked |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards card | Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite |
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite |

## 4. Authority and status

A tier change is applied only when the membership's status is active. Tier changes are made by Ashbury Rewards; guest services does not grant, match or extend a tier. Each tier's qualifying nights, qualifying spend and downgrade floor are the figures of that tier.

## Worked dates (hypothetical member)

| Event | Result |
|---|---|
| The net night credits of 2025 first reach 25 on 14 August 2025 | Upgrade to Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite effective 14 August 2025, guaranteed through 28 February 2027 |
| Reassessment on 1 March 2027 with 12 net night credits in 2026 | Highest tier met is Silver Elite; the Gold Elite floor is Silver Elite; new tier Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite, guaranteed through 29 February 2028 |
| Alternative: 3 net night credits in 2026 | Highest tier met is Member, below the Gold Elite floor; new tier Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite |

## Judgement on card floors (hypothetical members)

- A member who earned Ashbury Rewards Member by nights and links the Ashbury Rewards Premier card holds at least Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite while the card stays linked.
- A member who earned Platinum Elite by nights and holds the Ashbury Rewards card keeps Platinum Elite when the card is closed, because Platinum Elite is the higher of the two.
